messages:
rachel: Kicked off post-deploy consistency sweep after the canary promote. Noticing divergence between canary and baseline in the cross-region KV checksum probe for ap-south1.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026-03-23-canary -> canary pools. Post-deploy health checks started (ci: 4832109999).
sam: What divergence are we seeing? Checksums, payloads, or latency?
rachel: Checksums. The aggregator reports ~0.3% mismatches on recent probe batch (mostly short prefixes). Latency fine, no 5xx.
infra-ops: pulling reconciliation logs now. `grep "checksum=" /var/log/probe/kv-recon-ap-south1.log | tail -n 100` shows mismatches tied to node cache-7 handling of prefix normalization.
maya: That node recently got a kernel upgrade in the maintenance window; could be endian/locale patch? Weird but possible.
lucas: Proposal: hold the rest of the rollout and pin ap-south1 to previous variant while we validate reconciliation behavior. Also enable debug tracing for the probe payload transformation only in ap-south1 to avoid noise.
sam: Agreed. Action: pin region and enable debug traces. Keep rollout paused.
deploy-bot: Routing update: pin ap-south1 -> v2026-03-19. API call: 
```nPOST /api/v1/route/pin
{"region":"ap-south1","model_variant":"v2026-03-19","meta":"postdeploy-consistency-hold"}
```
deploy-bot: Response 200. ap-south1 pinned.
infra-ops: Enabled probe debug flag for ap-south1: `probe.debug=checksums` and raised log retention for 2h for that region.
rachel: Re-run of synthetic consistency sweep (2k samples) queued. First pass shows mismatches reduced to 0.02%. The remaining mismatches correlate with a specific prefix normalization edge-case.
maya: Good. Can we push a small normalization fix to the probe transformer and re-run against the original canary variant in a controlled canary? If that clears, we can unpin and continue.
lucas: We should also add a guard to the release notes and not auto-promote if cross-region checksum divergence > 0.1% in the first 10 minutes.
sam: Decision: leave ap-south1 pinned, schedule a targeted soft-patch to the probe transformer under canary tag (no model change) and run a focused reconciliation test. If the patch passes, we'll unpin and resume staged promote. If not, we'll keep pin and trigger postmortem.
rachel: I'll draft release notes: "ap-south1 pinned to v2026-03-19 due to transient KV checksum divergence observed during initial consistency sweep; probe transformer under verification."
deploy-bot: Release notes updated on the release record.
infra-ops: Opening infra ticket INF-900: investigate possible interaction with recent kernel package on cache-7. cc infra@.
maya: I'll open RT-6372 for the normalization edge-case and attach failing probe payloads.
sam: Monitor for 60m. If we see divergence again after unpin, escalate to a change window tomorrow morning. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
